query:
UPDATE outbox_events
        SET status = $3::text,
            attempt_count = $4,
            next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $5),
            processed_at = CASE WHEN $3::text = 'PROCESSED' THEN now() END,
            last_error = $6
        WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND next_attempt_at = $7
